summary: Master the art of prospecting and lead qualification with our comprehensive training course. Boost your sales skills and drive results today!
lede: Prospecting and lead qualification help sales and business development professionals identify promising buyers and focus on early-stage opportunities. Participants learn to define ideal customer profiles, choose outreach channels, and ask discovery questions that reveal fit, intent, and timing. They also practise scoring and prioritizing leads, disqualifying poor-fit prospects, and moving qualified opportunities toward clear next steps.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly prospect, qualify, and manage early-stage opportunities.
audience: Inside sales and SDR teams doing outreach
modules: Crafting Outreach Messages That Earn Attention
Discovery Questions That Reveal Truth Fast
Moving Qualified Leads Into Next Steps
Sales and Marketing Alignment on Lead Quality
prerequisites: Participants should have basic sales or business development experience. Familiarity with sales terminology and CRM systems is beneficial but not required.
